ArrayList implements List interface using resizable arrays, providing constant-time random access O(1) but linear-time O(n) insertion/deletion. LinkedList uses doubly-linked list structure offering O(1) insertion/deletion at arbitrary positions but requires O(n) traversal for random access. Choice depends on access pattern: frequent random access favors ArrayList, frequent modifications favor LinkedList.
